name: Domenica al museo
blurb: Free admission for everyone on the first Sunday of the month at Italy's state museums and archaeological parks, under the Ministry of Culture's Domenica al museo, during each site's usual opening hours. Some sites ask you to book a slot in advance. · Ingresso gratuito per tutti la prima domenica del mese.
_measured: 2026-09-27: 354 of the 375 sites on the official list, placed from the ministry's open data (dati.cultura.gov.it) or, where its point was missing or wrong (Aquileia and the Tomba di Cicerone were in Rome), from Wikidata or OSM - each site's _coords says which. 21 are left out, never guessed: closed for works, open to groups only, no single place, a comune the list gets wrong, an office. 20 kept sites show no Sunday hours on their ministry page and carry a note to check: the list is updated in real time and the hours are not (Crotone's national museum shows every day closed, with a ticket price). The rule, as published: "Domenica 6 settembre si rinnova l’appuntamento con la #domenicalmuseo, l’iniziativa del Ministero della Cultura che consente l’ingresso gratuito nei luoghi della cultura statali ogni prima domenica del mese. Le visite si svolgeranno nei consueti orari di apertura, con accesso con prenotazione consigliata o obbligatoria, dove richiesta. Info e biglietti sull’app “Musei Italiani”. [...] Il seguente "

name: Centre des monuments nationaux: premier dimanche
blurb: Free admission for everyone on the first Sunday of the month from November to March at monuments run by the Centre des monuments nationaux. · Entrée gratuite pour tous le premier dimanche du mois, de novembre à mars.
_measured: 2026-09-27: 68 of the 92 monuments on the official list, each monument's own page read for the months it is free (Carcassonne: January to March only; Reims's towers: March and November) and the days it is closed (27 close on 1 November, a holiday and a free Sunday in 2026). 24 are left out: excluded by the rule, closed in every free month, free every day, or no first-Sunday rule on their own page. The rule, as published: "3° Le centre des monuments nationaux accorde la gratuité du droit d’entrée les 1ers dimanches du mois du 1er janvier au 31 mars et du 1er novembre au 31 décembre pour l’ensemble de ses monuments (sauf pour le domaine national de Saint-Cloud et la Basilique cathédrale de St Denis). [Section 1° of the same page also states: "Les gratuités citées ci-dessous ne s'appliquent pas pour les monuments suiv"
